front: When were NATO and the Warsaw Pact formed?

back: The first artificial satellite, launched by the USSR on 4 October 1957.
Deterrence: a nuclear war would destroy both sides, so neither dares to start one.

front: Which powers mainly supplied ZIPRA and ZANLA?
back: ZIPRA (ZAPU): mainly the USSR. ZANLA (ZANU): mainly China.

front: Name four proxy wars of the Cold War.

back: The easing of superpower tension in the 1970s (e.g. SALT I, 1972).

front: When did the Cold War end?
back: The Berlin Wall opened on 9 November 1989; the USSR dissolved in December 1991.

front: Give three effects of the Cold War on Africa.
back: Rival movements armed, wars prolonged (Angola), dictators supported (Mobutu); its end helped Namibian independence.
